evals.prompt: Initialize a project spec index from README.md for this workspace using /ws-spec-index init

assertions: index.PRD contains standard sections: How to use, Status legend, Goal, Problems, Feature map by phase, Next specs, Inbox, Done log
no full acceptance criteria bodies are fabricated in index.PRD

evals.prompt: Run /ws-spec-index sync for a non-existent slug with no ship evidence

assertions: returns skipped reason indicating unmapped or missing evidence
no file edits are made to index.PRD

evals.prompt: Run /ws-spec-index sync with valid ship evidence for slug 01-feature-a

assertions: updates checkbox from [ ] to [x] for matching row
adds completed entry to Done log

evals.prompt: Run /ws-spec-index sync with valid ship evidence on an index.PRD using non-template headers (Status | Spec file)

assertions: matches slug and updates status checkbox in non-template dialect table
appends completed entry to Done log
